stories.title: Harbaugh: Giants pulled recent offer for RB Taylor but 'things do change'
stories.summary: The Giants pulled a recent trade offer for Jonathan Taylor, according to coach John Harbaugh, who added that doesn't mean a deal is completely off the table.

stories.title: Sources: Nacua to undergo tests on knee; Rams' initial belief is ACL intact
stories.summary: The Rams do not believe Puka Nacua suffered a torn ACL, but the imaging Monday will tell more, sources said.

stories.title: Sirianni not ruling out staff changes after Eagles' 7th straight loss
stories.summary: Nick Sirianni did not rule out the possibility of staff changes at the bye as he looks to find answers to what's ailing the Eagles, losers of seven in a row.

stories.title: Browns' Monken 'proud' of Shedeur but sidesteps questions on QB position
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said he was "proud" of Shedeur Sanders' performance in Cleveland's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints but refused to answer whether Sanders made a case to start going forward.

stories.title: Michigan, Whittingham fire Beck, seek 'change in leadership' on offense
stories.summary: A day after losing to rival Michigan State 15-6, Michigan fired offensive coordinator Jason Beck, the program announced Sunday afternoon. The Wolverines are 5-4 and have the No. 17 scoring offense in the Big Ten.
